end.summary:
Practised finding partners that make 100 using tens numbers and two-digit numbers.
Used jumps of 1 and 10 on a number line to reach 100.
Answered 30 + 70 and 87 to 100 correctly without help.
Initially gave 65 + 45, then corrected this to 65 + 35.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Vihaan practised making 100 and counting in jumps of 1 and 10 on a number line. They used the jump method correctly for 87 to 100 and later explained why 65 + 45 makes 110, not 100; this mix-up was corrected during the lesson. At home, practise a few pairs such as 62 + 38 and 74 + 26 by splitting the jumps to the next ten, then to 100.
